source.dimension: country + network city + exact canonical model path
source.method: De-duplicated model-page visitors mapped from an approximate network-city centroid to the published Atlas administrative boundary
source.snapshotNote: Each visitor contributes once to one eligible page and at most one mapped boundary.
source.snapshotLinkage: Country and regional aggregates are generated from the same sanitized visitor snapshot.

claimBoundary: Model-page interest only. A page visit is not verified model use and does not prove a download, installation, launch, or inference.

privacy.rule: Every observed regional model aggregate is published from one visitor.
privacy.withheldDetail: Only cells with zero observed visitors remain absent.
privacy.overlapNote: Counts are aggregate page-interest observations and must not be interpreted as downloads or verified usage.
